info.name: Job Portal Backend API - SRS v1.3
info.description: Generated from SRS v1.3. Contains UC-01 through UC-19 and all normative API paths. Public endpoints use No Auth; protected endpoints inherit Bearer {{accessToken}}. Exact JSON schemas are not fully defined for every endpoint in the SRS, so some sample bodies are explicitly marked as inferred from SRS field names/actions. Default localhost:8080 is a testing convenience, not an SRS requirement.
